The '''''Pioneer''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was built in a shipyard on [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
It was completed in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Date" /> along with the other ''Venators'' [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and [[Dauntless (Venator-class)|''Dauntless'']]. They were assembled together to act as a battle group and as their first mission, they were put under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

Along with the other two ships, the ''Pioneer'' was sent to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] to defend it from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. On the way to Bothawui, they had a couple of minor skirmishes with Grievous's fleet, but were able to reach it before they did. It participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], when Grievous finally arrived there.
